citation_aliases: Preventing Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market

coverage.summary: Applies to landlords' use of algorithmic rent coordination services in Jersey City rental housing; the passages state no size or building exemptions.

rules.effective_date_note: The secondary source gives only 'effective June 2025'; the ordinance text provided does not state an exact date.
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement
rules.requirement: Jersey City bans landlords from using algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance adds §218-12 to Chapter 218 and defines coordination as collecting nonpublic competitor data, processing it with software, and recommending rents, lease terms or occupancy levels. Enforcement is both public and private.
rules.review_note: The operative prohibition text, penalties and exact effective date are not in the passages. The description relies on a secondary law-firm table, the ordinance title and its definitions. Preemption by state law is not addressed in the passages.
rules.source_notes: Ord. 25-057 (official) adds new §218-12. A secondary table lists the effective date as June 2025.
rules.title: Preventing Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market
